bio_am: Ծնած է Շապին Գարահիսար։ Սասնոյ եւ Տարօնի ամենանշանաւոր հայդուկապետը, Ա. կամաւորական գունդի հրամանատար, մահացած է Կալիֆորնիա՝ 1927 Օգոստոս 30-ին։
bio_en: Andranik was born in Shabin-Karahisar into the family of a carpenter and followed his father's trade; married at seventeen, he was widowed within a year and, in Vratsian's words, 'married the homeland'. He became the most celebrated fedayi of Sasun and Taron, leading the defence of the Arakelots monastery in 1901 and, with Gevorg Chavush, Hrayr, Sebouh and Smbat, the Sasun uprising of 1904, after which he crossed into Persia; Nikol Duman, Keri and Sevkaretsi Sako were among his comrades. He twice left the ARF, in 1907 and 1917, as he himself explained in a 1924 article, but commanded the first Armenian volunteer regiment in the First World War and fought in Syunik and Zangezur in 1918-19. He died on 30 August 1927 at a spa near Richardson Springs in California and was buried in Fresno pending transfer to Armenia.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Birth year: #365 (Vratsian) says 1866, #368's year list has 1865 - conflict, 1865 used provisionally (verify). Commonly transliterated Andranik Ozanian; the surname does not appear in the portions read - transliteration only. Details of 1901 and 1918-19 from other archive stories (#20, #108, #548ff).
